name: Sherina Munaf
bio: Sinna Sherina Munaf or better known as Sherina Munaf (born 11 June 1990) is an Indonesian actress, singer and songwriter of Minangkabau descent.

credits.title: Philosophy of the Porch
credits.overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

credits.title: Sherina's Adventure 2
credits.overview: Sherina is now an adult and works as a journalist. While Sadam is no longer Mami's child but a traveler. The two then went on an adventure in the jungles of Borneo.

credits.title: Earwig and the Witch
credits.overview: A headstrong orphan discovers a world of spells and potions while living with a selfish witch.

credits.title: Wiro Sableng: 212 Warrior
credits.overview: After being trained in the art of silat, a disciple gets sent on a journey by his mentor to take down a treacherous e-pupil with a villainous plan.

credits.title: Sherina's Adventure
credits.overview: A girl who struggles at her new school must team up with a classmate giving her major headaches when trouble finds them both in this musical adventure.
